description: One element's full sheet, for the DM who opens it: the element's id, name, kind (pj, pnj, lieu or evenement), aliases, description and notes. A PC or an NPC also carries its sheet: its six abilities (FOR, DEX, CON, INT, SAG, CHA) and the modifier of each, computed from the score and never stored (AbilityModifier@1: a DEX of 18 gives +4), armour class and maximum hit points, its features (actions then spells, each with a name and a text), its initial prompt, background and behaviour, its D&D Beyond link and its token: the colour, the initials of the name, whether it has a portrait (and its crop) and whether it has a dedicated image. With neither a portrait nor a token image the token is the initials on the colour. A PC carries the id of its player; an NPC has none. An unknown element has no answer (null).
